parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` (package: Artwork) and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` (package: Metadata). Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Additionally, the two types differ in a semantically meaningful way — `responses:[Data]` vs `responses:[String: Data]` — reflecting genuinely different stubbing contracts (sequential array-indexed responses vs. URL-keyed dictionary responses), so the structural overlap is partly coincidental. Lifting these into a shared generic test helper would couple two unrelated test packages and risk obscuring the intent of each fixture.
